The '''Underground Tunnels''' were a series of subterranean tunnels and pipelines connected to [[Vobbara Yusinduu]]'s [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] [[Refining Factory|refinery]] in the [[Minboosa District]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. The tunnels were [[Raid on the Minboosa District|attacked]] by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] of the [[Hidden Chain]] during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR:TPB" />
